# sngl:json on every target: a declared type read from text and written back,
# its marks naming fields and members on the wire, and the failures, worded
# alike everywhere, that say where text did not match.

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout '5 tests, 0 failures'

-- app.sngl --
// sngl:json reads text as a declared type and writes a value back: a field
// named on the wire by its mark, an option a key that may be missing or null,
// an enum by its member's name, dates as RFC 3339 text, a map of any keys, a
// type that holds itself -- and a failure naming where the text did not match.

import async "sngl:async"
import json "sngl:json"
import time "sngl:time"
import . "sngl:test"
import . "sngl:ui"

enum Kind {
    #[json.identifier("fire-type")]
    fire
    water
}

struct Stat {
    #[json.identifier("base_stat")]
    baseStat int
    name     string
}

struct Mon {
    id     int
    name   string
    #[json.identifier("base_experience")]
    exp    option[int]
    kind   Kind
    stats  list[Stat]
    weight float
    tags   map[string, float]
    caught option[time.date]
    seen   time.datetime
}

struct Tree {
    label    string
    children list[Tree]
}

const sample = `{"id": 1, "name": "bulba", "kind": "fire-type", "extra": [1, 2],
    "stats": [{"base_stat": 45, "name": "hp"}, {"base_stat": 49, "name": "attack"}],
    "weight": 6.9, "tags": {"b": 2, "a": 0.5}, "caught": null, "seen": "2024-03-01T12:00:00Z"}`

func failure[T any](r async.Result[T]) => match r {
    ok => ""
    failed(var f) => "{f.kind}: {f.message}"
}

func testDecode(t Test) {
    match json.decode[Mon](sample) {
        ok(var m) {
            t.assert(m.id == 1)
            t.assert(m.name == "bulba")
            t.assert(m.exp == null)
            t.assert(m.kind == Kind.fire)
            t.assert(m.stats.length() == 2)
            t.assert(m.stats[1].baseStat == 49)
            t.assert(m.weight == 6.9)
            t.assert(m.tags.get("a", 0.0) == 0.5)
            t.assert(m.caught == null)
        }
        failed(var f) { t.assert(f.message == "") }
    }
}

// Built in program code, where a date written as text is parsed.
func squirtle() Mon {
    return Mon{
        id = 7,
        name = "squirtle \"blue\"",
        exp = 63,
        kind = Kind.water,
        stats = [Stat{baseStat=44, name="hp"}],
        weight = 9.0,
        tags = {"z" = 1.5, "a" = 2.0},
        caught = time.date("2024-03-01"),
        seen = "2024-03-01T12:00:00Z",
    }
}

func testEncode(t Test) {
    var m = squirtle()
    t.assert(json.encode(m) == `{"id":7,"name":"squirtle \"blue\"","base_experience":63,"kind":"water","stats":[{"base_stat":44,"name":"hp"}],"weight":9,"tags":{"a":2,"z":1.5},"caught":"2024-03-01","seen":"2024-03-01T12:00:00Z"}`)
    t.assert(json.encode([1.5, 0.25, 100.0]) == "[1.5,0.25,100]")
    t.assert(json.encode("tab\tline\n") == `"tab\tline\n"`)
}

func testRoundTrip(t Test) {
    var tree = Tree{label="root", children=[Tree{label="a", children=[]}, Tree{label="b", children=[Tree{label="c", children=[]}]}]}
    var out = json.encode(tree)
    t.assert(out == `{"label":"root","children":[{"label":"a","children":[]},{"label":"b","children":[{"label":"c","children":[]}]}]}`)
    match json.decode[Tree](out) {
        ok(var back) {
            t.assert(back.children[1].children[0].label == "c")
            t.assert(json.encode(back) == out)
        }
        failed(var f) { t.assert(f.message == "") }
    }
}

func testFailures(t Test) {
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[Mon](`{"id": 1.5}`)) == "decode: $.id: want an integer")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[Mon](`{"id": 1}`)) == "decode: $.name: missing")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[list[Stat]](`[{"base_stat": 1, "name": 2}]`)) == "decode: $[0].name: want a string")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[Kind](`"grass"`)) == "decode: $: want one of fire-type, water")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[int](`[1`)) == "decode: not JSON")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[map[string, int]](`{"b": 1, "a": "x"}`)) == "decode: $.a: want an integer")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[time.date](`"2024-02-30"`)) == "decode: $: want a date")
    t.assert(failure(json.decode[option[int]](`null`)) == "")
}

component panel node {
    var shown = "-"
    text #result(value=shown)
    button #run(text="Decode", @click {
        match json.decode[Stat](`{"base_stat": 3, "name": "speed"}`) {
            ok(var s) { shown = "{s.name} {s.baseStat}" }
            failed(var f) { shown = f.message }
        }
    })
}

func testInAHandler(t Test, c panel) {
    c.run.click()
    t.assert(c.result.value == "speed 3")
}

window {
    panel
}
